newsitem.title: UK: SHELL ON NATWEST LIST OF EXPECTED OUTPERFORMERS.
newsitem.headline: SHELL ON NATWEST LIST OF EXPECTED OUTPERFORMERS.

text.p: Strategists at NatWest Securities named 15 stocks they expect to outperform during 1997, market sources said on Friday.

The 15 were BAA Plc , Boots Co Plc , British Aerospace Plc , British Airways Plc , Bryant Group Plc , British Telecommunications Plc , Ladbroke Plc , Lloyds TSB Group Plc , National Power Plc , Pearson Plc , Royal Sun Alliance Plc , Shell Transport & Trading Co Plc , Standard Chartered Plc , United Assurance Group Plc and Whitbread Plc .
Analysts at the brokerage were not immediately for comment.
